definitions.explanation: The process of something becoming widespread or commonly used throughout society.
The act of making something widely known or available to the general public.

examples.japanese: スマートフォンが{世界中|せかいじゅう}に{普及|ふきゅう}した。
examples.english: Smartphones have spread throughout the world.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{普及|ふきゅう}させるには{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: It takes time to disseminate new technology.

examples.japanese: インターネットの{普及|ふきゅう}により、{情報|じょうほう}へのアクセスが{容易|ようい}になった。
examples.english: Thanks to the spread of the internet, access to information has become easier.

notes:
USAGE:
・{普及|ふきゅう}する - to spread, become widespread (intransitive)
・{普及|ふきゅう}させる - to disseminate, popularize (transitive/causative)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{急速|きゅうそく}に{普及|ふきゅう}する - to spread rapidly
・{広|ひろ}く{普及|ふきゅう}している - to be widely used
・{普及|ふきゅう}{率|りつ} - penetration rate, adoption rate
・{普及|ふきゅう}{活動|かつどう} - promotional activities

RELATED:
・{浸透|しんとう} - permeation (more gradual, deeper adoption)
・{拡大|かくだい} - expansion
・{流行|りゅうこう} - trend, being in fashion
